definitions.gloss: actually, in fact, to tell the truth
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce new or surprising information, often something that contradicts expectations or that the speaker has been hesitant to reveal.

examples.japanese: {実|じつ}は、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Actually, I've also been to Japan.
To tell the truth, that story was a lie.

examples.japanese: {実|じつ}は、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧ん⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Actually, it turns out I'm going abroad starting tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}していた→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{実|じつ}は⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She was talking with a smile, but actually she was going through a very hard time.

notes:
{実|じつ}は is used to introduce truthful or surprising information. It signals that what follows may be unexpected or previously unknown.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
- Usually appears at the beginning of a sentence
- Can also appear before the main clause within a sentence

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Revealing hidden truth: {実|じつ}は、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (Actually, she's my older sister)
- Correcting a misunderstanding: {実|じつ}は⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ん⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (Actually, that's not right)
- Introducing a confession: {実|じつ}は⟦{困|こま}っています→困る：00861_komaru⟧ (To be honest, I'm troubled)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}は→本当は：02575_hontouha⟧: similar meaning, slightly more emphatic
- ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧): 'in reality' - more objective
- ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}うと→言う：00515_iu⟧: 'to be honest' - more explicit about honesty
